verification_status.verification_notes: The lead named the 'Glasgow Excellence Scholarship', but Glasgow's Excellence Award is for UK students only; this record covers the Global Leadership Scholarship, which Nigerians can get. The page says applications are open now; opening date not stated. A separate September-entry version of this scholarship exists and was not researched. Partial award (fee discount only). Number of awards is 'variable'. Successful candidates are told within six weeks of their programme offer.
